name: I Didn't Study | Cone's 2024 Gamejam Submission
desc:
You completely forgot you had a test tomorrow! There's no time to study... Quick! find a way to cheat!

A short escape-room style game made in 3 days.

This game relies on failing and retrying, solve puzzles to unlock smarter ways to cheat!

Click on items to interact with them to possibly help you! 

Made for the Fall 2024 Coneland Gamejam by Snap Shot Studios (Snoogle and Alpysk)
